posts.cooked:
THE CHAIRMAN - ROUND 1

The Chairman (35)
The Operative (45)

Start of Turn: (nothing)

Play:  Undivided Attention; Operative hits Expatriette for 4 melee [25]; Chairman hits Tachyon for 3 melee [24]

End of Turn:

Operative puts The Fence [underboss] (6) into play
The Fence puts The Thief [thug] (2) into play

The Thief finds nothing to destroy.

========================
Effects:
- The Chairman is immune to damage (Chairman)
- The Heroes cannot win the game (Operative)
- Whenever a villain card is destroyed the Operative deals the hero with the highest HP 3 melee damage (Operative)
- Reduce damage to the Chairman and Operative by 1 (adv Operative)
- Whenever a hero card is destroyed the Chairman and the Operative regain 3 HP (Fence)

(Start of Turn)
- If there are at any underbosses in the villain trash, flip the chairman's character cards (adv Chairman)

(End of Turn)
- Reveal cards from the top of the villain deck until an underboss card is revealed.  (Operative)
- Deal the hero target with the lowest HP 5 melee damage unless their player discards 1 card (Enforcers)
- Search the villain trash for a card named Thief and put it into play (Fence)

- Destroy a hero ongoing or equipment card (Thief)
==========
Chairman  (35) (immune) (DR1)  "Can't I even take a little resort vacation without these 'heroes' interfering?"
Operative (45) (DR1)
Thief (2) [thug]
The Fence (6) [underboss]

Villain Trash: Undivided Attention, Enforcers (x2), Hired Gun (x2), Informant (x2), Crooked Cop (x2), Thief
==========
Argent Adept - 24
Expatriette  - 25
Parse        - 26
Omnitron-X   - 25
Tachyon      - 24
